---

Tracer Morant, expert in firearms and ballistics, scanned the area, searching for any signs of the aliens. She quickly spotted a large, metallic object that appeared to be a communications array. She knew that she couldn't simply take it down without a plan.

"Lars Overholsen, you are currently demolishing the Tenerife Optical Ground Station, which you have successfully breached. I suggest you move forward with caution, for there may be more surprises in store," you explained, taking a few steps back, keeping a safe distance.

Kiki Vaughn, the engineer, tinkerer, and martial arts and gymnast, eyed the crate of explosives. She knew that with the right ingredients and equipment, she could create a powerful weapon capable of taking out the communications array.

"Ordnance, I will attempt to create a makeshift explosive device using the Tenerife Optical Ground Station components. But be warned, this could be dangerous territory if I go too far," you said, a slight hint of panic in your voice.

As the players watched your movements, they couldn't help but wonder what other surprises you might have in store, but they knew that they had no choice but to trust your abilities and your plan.

---

The group carefully sidesteps the security drones, moving deeper into the facility. Suddenly, they come across a group of aliens, watching them with an almost sadistic gaze.

"What is their purpose here?" Overholsen asked, a hint of pride in his voice.

Kiki Vaughn, "I sense a great deal of power and control behind this. They must have taken the communications array to further their sinister agendas."

Kiki Vaughn carefully takes out her detonator device and sets it on the ground, watching as it glows with an intense blue light. She then reaches for her wrench and begins to work on the explosives.

"I can feel the energy in these components. It will be a challenge, but I will not let them succeed," she said, determination in her voice.

As the group continues to explore the facility, they come across a group of aliens attacking a group of resistance fighters. The group quickly takes them down, but the aliens are relentless.
